notes: MADToken is a fixed-supply ERC-20 with 18 decimals. Its argument-free constructor mints all 1,000,000,000 MAD to msg.sender, the factory at launch. It has no owner, additional minting, transfer fees, or privileged balance controls. No application contracts are deployed. pool.initialPrice records provenance only; the opening price is derived from economics.initialMarketCapWei and token.totalSupply.
